cases.name: m2_base_b1_l1_d32
cases.note: smallest shape; L=1 under CHUNK_SIZE=256 exercises the sub-chunk arm (one padded chunk) and is the decode step shape; seg.L/cb.G recorded (size allows)

cases.name: m2_base_b2_l4_d32
cases.note: L = d_conv, the conv window exactly fills; sub-chunk arm; seg.L/cb.G recorded (size allows)

cases.name: m2_base_b3_l4_d64
cases.note: d_model 64 (H=2, the first multi-head shape), odd batch, sub-chunk arm; full stages, seg.L/cb.G elided for size

cases.name: m2_base_b1_l256_d32
cases.note: exactly one chunk, zero padding; the chunk boundary NOT crossed (the L=257 cases are the crossing)

cases.name: m2_base_b1_l257_d64
cases.note: one past the chunk boundary at d_model 64 (H=2); two chunks, second nearly all padding

cases.name: m2_comp_b2_l257_d32
cases.note: composition parent: B=2 at L=257; its rows are m2_comp_row0/row1 with the SAME parameters (batch-composition corpus rows, contract 8c is the lane's gate)

cases.name: m2_comp_row0_b1_l257_d32
cases.note: row 0 of m2_comp_b2_l257_d32 as a B=1 case (same seed, same parameters, x = parent x[0])

cases.name: m2_statepass_b1_l513_d32
cases.note: three chunks -> a TWO-HOP inter-chunk decay, the STATEPASS_MATRIX/STATEPASS_UNFUSED witness (contract 8f); A_log in [-4,-1] so A is in [-0.368, -0.018] and exp(dA_cs_last) stays a normal FP32 number over >= 2 hops (default range underflows some heads and leaves the arms inert)

cases.name: m2_statepass_b2_l770_d64
cases.note: four chunks (770 = 3*256 + 2, sub-chunk tail), B=2, H=2; the longest composition row; same liveness override as m2_statepass_b1_l513_d32

cases.name: m2_adv_softplus_band_b2_l8_d32
cases.note: (a) biased dt lands IN the distinguishing band [8, 14] where softplus(x) - x = log1p(exp(-x)) is 1..340 ulp of x (the contract's band rule: a 20-straddling fixture is vacuous, the mamba1 adv_softplus_guard lesson); A_log tiny keeps dt*A ~ -6e-5 per token so the scan stays alive

cases.name: m2_adv_a_near_zero_b3_l64_d32
cases.note: (b) A in [-6.1e-6, -1.5e-8]; per-chunk decay within a few ulp of 1 in FP32 and the S15 subtraction dA_cs_last - dA_cs is cancellation-prone (the contract's named A-near-zero case)

cases.name: m2_adv_signed_zeros_b2_l8_d32
cases.note: (c) x carries whole +0.0 tokens, whole -0.0 tokens and scattered -0.0 (the mamba1 rule verbatim); zero-sign propagation through the S1 fold and the S4 GEMM cells is compared BY SIGN BIT by the lane, which the tolerance cannot see

cases.name: m2_adv_gate_saturation_b1_l8_d64
cases.note: (d) the z rows of in_proj.weight (rows 0..d_inner, the zxbcdt order z | xBC | dt of mamba2.py:211-215) are in [-2^30, 2^30]; z is ~1e9-1e10, silu(z) saturates to -0.0 / z, and gnorm.gate is dominated by saturated products

cases.name: m2_adv_dt_limit_b2_l8_d32
cases.note: (e) ACTIVE dt_limit (0.001, 0.1) planted (contract 8f, the CLAMP_BEFORE_SOFTPLUS witness); limits are the FP32 values (hex in the manifest); dt_bias widened to [-9,-1] so softplus output spans [7.5e-5, 0.47] and BOTH limits bind

cases.name: m2_init_states_b1_l257_d32
cases.note: (f) nonzero hashed initial_states [B,H,P,N] (ssd_minimal.py:64-66 semantics, prepended as chunk -1's state); at L=257 this is the OTHER STATEPASS witness (contract 8f: a zero-init two-chunk case is bitwise inert); same A_log liveness override

cases.name: m2_decode_b1_l260p1_d32
cases.note: (g) decode continuation: prefill 260 (one COMPLETED chunk + a 4-row open-chunk buffer), then ONE token; records the three-piece resumption state of contract section 5 (conv window, boundary h, intra-chunk buffer) and the decode token's per-stage rows. DEVIATION 786: decode IS prefill resumption, so the L=261 prefill IS the decode reference

seed_rule: seed_k = seed_base + 0x1000 * k, k = case index below; x_source cases reuse the parent's seed

stage_definitions.cb.G: S12: C.B contracted over n (HF :302); one group row at ngroups = 1 (heads are bitwise copies)  [B, C, G, Q, Q]
stage_definitions.conv.out: S6: causal depthwise conv1d over raw xBC, kernel 4, padding 3, truncated to L, bias included (mamba2.py:233)  [M, CD]
stage_definitions.conv.window: the conv window AFTER the call: last d_conv raw xBC columns per channel, zeros before the first token (mamba2.py:220-221, allocate_inference_cache:348-350)  [B, CD, 4]
stage_definitions.cstate.out: S15-S16: (B (.) decay)^T . X_d per (b, chunk) (HF :313-314)  [B, C, H, P, N]
stage_definitions.dacs.out: S11: per-chunk cumsum of dA = A * dt (HF :289, :294-295); padded positions carry the last real value  [B, H, C, Q]
stage_definitions.decay.states: S15: exp(dA_cs_last - dA_cs) (HF :312)  [B, H, C, Q]
stage_definitions.dt.out: S9: clamp(softplus(dt_raw + dt_bias), dt_limit), in that order (_chunk_cumsum_fwd_kernel:73-81; HF :272-276; torch softplus threshold 20 == the kernel's <= 20 guard)  [M, H]
stage_definitions.gnorm.gate: S21: y * silu(z), gate BEFORE norm (rms_norm_ref:26-27, norm_before_gate=False)  [M, d_ssm]
stage_definitions.gnorm.out: S21: gate * (1/sqrt(sumsq/d_ssm + 1e-5)) * norm.weight (rms_norm_ref:29-30; eps mamba2.py:144; group_size = whole row at G = 1, DEVIATION 787)  [M, d_ssm]
stage_definitions.gnorm.sumsq: S21: the gated row's sum-of-squares fold  [M]
stage_definitions.in_proj.out: S4: norm.out @ in_proj.weight^T; columns z | xBC | dt_raw (mamba2.py:211-215, d_mlp = 0)  [M, 2*d_inner + 2*G*N + H]
stage_definitions.input.x: the block input, as given, token-major  [M, d_model]
stage_definitions.norm.out: S2-S3: x * (1/sqrt(sumsq/d_model + 1e-5)) * weight (rstd per rms_norm_ref:29, the mamba_ssm spelling; order HF :604-605)  [M, d_model]
stage_definitions.norm.sumsq: S1: per-row sum of squares (HF Mamba2RMSNorm :603 spells mean(-1); recorded as the fold's SUM, the card's decomposition)  [M]
stage_definitions.pass.states: S17: the state ENTERING each chunk (h_{c-1}); reference spelling is the decay-matrix pass (HF :318-326 / ssd_minimal.py:64-69); the PROFILE pins the serial fma recurrence (DEVIATION 785) and this float64 reference absorbs the difference in tolerance  [B, C, H, P, N]
stage_definitions.scan.y: S19: Y_diag + Y_off (HF :335), truncated  [M, H, P]
stage_definitions.seg.L: S12: exp(segsum), +0.0 above the diagonal (HF :299 / ssd_minimal.py:54; exp(-inf) = +0.0 = the profile's structural zero, DEVIATION 782)  [B, C, H, Q, Q]
stage_definitions.silu.out: S7: silu(conv.out) (mamba2.py:232); columns x | B | C split by copy (:243)  [M, CD]
stage_definitions.skip.out: S20: Y + x * D[h], D from UNDISCRETIZED post-conv x, added LAST (HF :284-285, :338-339)  [M, H, P]
stage_definitions.ssd.h_last: section 5's REPORT stage: the S17 value after the final (padded) chunk (ssd_minimal.py:69; mamba2.py:261-264); NOT the resumption state off a chunk boundary  [B, H, P, N]
stage_definitions.xd.out: S10: x * dt, DISCRETIZE FIRST (HF :288; ssd_minimal.py:103 composition; DEVIATION 789: dt binds to x and A, never to B)  [M, H, P]
stage_definitions.ydiag.out: S13-S14: (G (.) L) . X_d over chunk positions (HF :305-308), truncated to L  [M, H, P]
stage_definitions.yoff.out: S18: (C . h_prev) * exp(dA_cs), contract over n FIRST, scale AFTER (HF :330-332), truncated  [M, H, P]
